READ_THIS_FIRST.instruction_for_ai: DO NOT calculate totals from individual activities. Use the pre-calculated values in 'summary', 'weekly_summary', and 'derived_metrics' sections below. These are already computed accurately from the API data.
READ_THIS_FIRST.extended_data_note: ACWR and baselines calculated from 28 days of data
READ_THIS_FIRST.capability_metrics_note: The 'capability' block in derived_metrics contains durability trend (aggregate decoupling 7d/28d) and TID comparison (7d vs 28d distribution drift). These measure HOW the athlete expresses fitness, not just load. Use these for coaching context alongside traditional load metrics. Durability trend direction matters more than absolute values.

alerts.context: ACWR 0.48 outside safe range. Injury/overreach risk elevated.

summary.note: Duration calculated from API moving_time field.

fitness.fitness_source: Decayed from yesterday (today's planned workouts not yet completed)

derived_metrics.grey_zone_note: Gray Zone % (Z3/tempo) - minimize in polarized training
derived_metrics.quality_intensity_note: Quality Intensity % (Z4+/threshold+) - target ~20% in polarized training
derived_metrics.polarisation_note: Easy time (Z1+Z2) / Total - target ~80% in polarized training
derived_metrics.hard_days_note: Zone ladder: z3+ >= 30min, z4+ >= 10min, z5+ >= 5min, z6+ >= 2min, z7 >= 1min. Cumulative thresholds per Seiler/Foster — higher zones need less time to qualify as hard

durability.note: Steady-state power sessions only (VI <= 1.05, VI > 0, >= 90min, power data). Negative decoupling = strong durability. Trend compares 7d vs 28d mean (+/-1% = stable).

tid_comparison.note: Compares 7d vs 28d Seiler TID to detect distribution shifts. pi_delta positive = more polarized acutely.

planned_workouts.name: Planned Workout
planned_workouts.description:
Z2 长有氧 4h — 本周主菜。这是有氧功率和抗疲劳的底层。

🔴 髂腰肌 gate（10/07 + 10/08 已记拉伤，你连着 3 天没上车）：
① 出门前自测：抬腿 / 弓步 / 深蹲时髋前侧有牵扯痛 → 今天别骑长途，改室内 Z2 90min 或全休。
② 骑中髋前侧一出现疼痛 → 立刻收车，不要为了凑 4h 硬撑。
③ 全程坐姿、轻齿比、零扭矩；禁止摇车，站起来松腿时也别用力蹬。
④ 无痛骑满 2h 就算过关。能骑到 3-4h 更好；按实际时长记账，今天不追 load。
心率锁 145 —— 带伤 + 缺三天训练，心率会比平时虚高，更要守住。
补给：每小时 60 g 碳水 + 500-750 ml 水，第 40 分钟开吃。
✅ 强烈建议户外（你户外最长 8h02m，4 小时对你不是新鲜事）。若髋部不适，室内最多 3h。

功率（双口径）：
  主段 台子/ERG 127-145 W（63-72%） → 表上功率计读到 133-152 W
  65-72%（台子 131-145 W）用于 90-120 min 的课；63-68%（台子 127-137 W）用于 3 h 以上的课。
  心率上限：90-120 min 的课锁 148；3 h 以上的课锁 145。
补给：每小时 50-60 g 碳水 + 500-750 ml 水，第 40 分钟就开吃。

Warmup
- 15m ramp 50-62% 85rpm

Main Set
- 50m 63-68% 85rpm
- 5m 50% 75rpm
- 50m 63-68% 85rpm
- 5m 50% 75rpm
- 50m 63-68% 85rpm
- 5m 50% 75rpm
- 50m 63-68% 85rpm

Cooldown
- 10m 50% 75rpm

planned_workouts.name: Planned Workout
planned_workouts.description:
低踏频 SST 4x8min — 补陡坡死角：8% 以上你在 58-65 rpm 推不动。这是辅助课，不是主线。

功率（双口径）：
  工作段 4x8min @82-88%：台子 166-178 W（锚 172）→ 表上 173-186 W
  踏频锁 58-65 rpm —— 这是本课唯一的重点。宁可功率低 5 W，也要守住低踏频。
  组间 4min @50% 轻松转：台子 101 W → 表上 106 W
坐姿为主，重心后压、上身放松、别摇车。膝盖前侧有不适立刻停，不要硬扛。
低踏频下心率会偏低，别去看心率 —— 看踏频和功率。

- 5m 70% 80rpm

VO2max 5x4min — 把功率天花板往上顶。这是 20 分钟功率的上游，比低踏频更贴你的主目标。

  工作段 5x4min @108-112%：台子 218-226 W（锚 222）→ 表上 228-236 W

质量优先：若第 4 段功率掉超过 5%，第 5 段直接不做。
热身别跳：12m ramp 后先骑 3min @95-100% 把心率提上来。
